title: RecMem: Recurrent Memory Compression for Long-Sequence Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.17921v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative recommendation benefits from long interaction histories, but the cost of processing them directly grows with history length. We propose RecMem, a recurrent memory compression framework guided by three desiderata: space invariance, semantic fidelity, and lifelong evolvability. RecMem compresses historical segments into a fixed set of memory slots using a bifurcated encoder-decoder with shared lower layers and slot-wise forget-gated updates. Recommendation supervision trains the memory to preserve predictive information, while stream-consistency training aligns predictions from sequential and packed processing. By construction, the memory state and decoder context are independent of history length; under contraction and approximate semigroup consistency, we further derive a horizon-independent bound on the state discrepancy between these two processing orders. translated_title: RecMem：面向长序列生成式推荐的循环记忆压缩
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐受益于长交互历史，但直接处理这些历史的成本会随历史长度的增长而增加。我们提出RecMem，一个循环记忆压缩框架，其设计遵循三个目标：空间不变性、语义保真度和终身可演化性。RecMem采用分叉式编码器-解码器（共享底层）以及逐记忆槽的遗忘门控更新，将历史片段压缩到一组固定的记忆槽中。推荐监督训练使记忆保留具有预测价值的信息，而流一致性训练则对齐顺序处理与打包处理两种方式下的预测结果。通过构造，记忆状态和解码器上下文与历史长度无关；在收缩性和近似半群一致性条件下，我们进一步推导出这两种处理顺序之间状态差异的与时间视界无关的界限。在MerRec数据集上，RecMem仅使用16个记忆槽和216个token的解码器上下文……
tldr: RecMem提出一种循环记忆压缩框架，将长交互历史压缩为固定数量的记忆槽，使内存与计算开销不随历史长度增长，同时通过推荐监督与流一致性训练保证预测信息保真与不同处理顺序下的一致性。
en_tdlr: RecMem is a recurrent memory compression framework that compresses long interaction histories into a fixed set of memory slots, achieving history-length-independent memory and decoding cost while preserving predictive information through recommendation supervision and stream-consistency training.
